page.overview:
What is Abbey Mountains?

The Abbey Mountains, also known as the Turnback Mountains, were a range of tall peaks in the Moonsea North region of north Faerun. They were originally known as the Dragonheart Mountains prior to the establishment of the Abbey of the Moon during the age of Netheril, and also known as Rabrae Hyuk to the local gnoll population.

The range was quite frigid and windswept, with only the topmost peaks getting consistent snow caps.

The Abbey Mountains were located between the Tortured Land and the Frozen Forest, southwest of the Great Glacier.

The foothills along the northern face of the Abbey range were known locally as the "Mammothbacks".
